facts.about: Interglobe Aviation Ltd (Indigo) is India’s largest passenger airline operating as a low-cost carrier. Serving 86 destinations including 24 international destinations, it provides passengers with a simple, unbundled product, fulfilling its singular brand promise of providing “low fares, on-time flights, and a courteous and hassle-free service” to its customers. IndiGo commenced operations in August 2006 with a single aircraft and has grown its fleet to 262 aircrafts.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 1274% of PAT

business.summary: InterGlobe Aviation Limited operates passenger airline services, primarily under the IndiGo brand, and generates revenue through passenger ticket sales, cancellation fees, and related aviation services.

segments.name: Passenger Services

guidance.statement: Expect capacity to grow in the early single digit year-on-year for the third quarter.
guidance.quote: Moving to our outlook for the third quarter of this financial year, we expect capacity to grow in the early single digit year-on-year.

guidance.statement: Expect PRASK to grow by more than 25 percent year-on-year in Q3.
guidance.quote: Based on the trends observed in October, we expect PRASK to grow by more than 25 percent year-on-year.

guidance.statement: Expect capacity to grow in the early single digits for the full financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: For the full financial year 2027, we expect capacity to grow in the early single digits.

guidance.statement: Expect CASK ex fuel ex forex MTM to increase in high single digits to early double digits range.
guidance.quote: On the cost side, we expect CASK ex fuel ex forex MTM to increase in the high single digits to early double digits range

guidance.statement: expecting a flattish capacity growth in Q2 FY27 compared to the same period last year
guidance.quote: As a result, we are expecting a flattish capacity growth in Q2 FY27 compared to the same period last year.

guidance.statement: expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year
guidance.quote: In terms of unit passenger revenue or PRASK for Q2FY27, with the current balanced demand-supply equation and the higher fares holding up, we are expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year.

guidance.statement: holding to single-digit capacity guidance for the full year
guidance.quote: Given the external factors, we are still holding to the single-digit guidance that we will on capacity.

guidance.statement: expecting cost CASK ex fuel to be on the higher side of single digit or early double digit
guidance.quote: So, for the year, we are still going to be on the higher side of this single digit, possibly even lower end of the early double-digit ranges.

guidance.statement: holding to mid-teens capacity growth from FY2028 to FY2030
guidance.quote: No, we still hold to the mid-teens. That is going to be from FY2028 to FY 2030.

guidance.statement: Expecting mid-single digit percentage increase in unit costs excluding fuel and forex for full financial year 2026
guidance.quote: We are currently estimating mid-single digit percentage increase in our unit costs excluding fuel and forex for the full financial year 2026 as compared to the full financial year 2025

guidance.statement: Expecting to add capacity of around 10 percent in the fourth quarter compared to same period last year
guidance.quote: Moving on to the forecast for the fourth quarter of this financial year, we are expecting to add capacity of around 10 percent as compared to the same period last year.

guidance.statement: Estimating early to mid single digit moderation in unit passenger revenue compared to high base last year
guidance.quote: Further, on the revenue side, basis the trends that we see in January, we are estimating an early to mid single digit moderation in our unit passenger revenue as compared to a high base of the same quarter last year

scorecard.promised: Flattish capacity growth in Q2 FY27 compared to the same period last year.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 25.9% YoY in Sep 2026 (Q2 FY27), suggesting capacity was not flattish.
scorecard.evidence: Revenue growth of 25.9% in Sep 2026 far exceeds 'flattish' guidance despite yield growth claims.

scorecard.promised: Expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Total revenue grew 25.9% YoY in Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Revenue growth of 25.9% in Sep 2026 aligns with the PRASK growth target of >25%.

scorecard.promised: Expecting to add capacity of around 10 percent in Q4 FY26.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew only 1.3% YoY in Mar 2026 (Q4 FY26).
scorecard.evidence: Revenue growth of 1.3% in Mar 2026 indicates capacity addition was likely well below 10%.

scorecard.promised: Early to mid single digit moderation in unit passenger revenue in Q4 FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Flat revenue growth (1.3%) supports the narrative of unit revenue moderation against a high base.

scorecard.promised: Holding to single-digit capacity guidance for the full year FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 19.9% in Q1 and 25.9% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Strong H1 revenue growth makes single-digit full-year capacity growth look conservative or unlikely.

narrative.scoreline: Management is struggling to balance capacity guidance with volatile operational realities, leading to significant quarterly earnings misses and high leverage.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Reported a net loss of 19 billion rupees in Q2 FY27 due to elevated costs.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Sep 2026 (Q2 FY27) shows a PAT loss of ₹1,879 crore (approx. 18.8 billion rupees).

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: June quarter (Q1 FY27) total income of 256 billion rupees, up ~19% YoY.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Jun 2026 (Q1 FY27) revenue was ₹24,584 crore, up 19.9% YoY.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Fuel CASK increased by around 80% year-on-year.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margins collapsed from 26% in Jun 2025 to 13% in Jun 2026.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated to 25.9% in Sep 2026 despite seasonal softness and high fuel costs.
Strong cash flow generation with CFO of ₹23,470 crore in FY26 despite reporting a net loss.
Dominant market position maintained with 57 aircraft deliveries in 2025, the largest globally from Airbus.
bear: Net worth has eroded to ₹4,996 crore against a massive debt load of ₹87,303 crore.
Company reported a full-year net loss of ₹2,394 crore in FY26, reversing FY25's ₹7,258 crore profit.
Operating margins have trended downward from 24% in FY24 to 14% in FY26.
watch: Check if Q3 FY27 PRASK growth exceeds 25% as guided in October trends.

claims.claim: Reported a net loss of 19 billion rupees due to exceptionally high fuel costs and a seasonally soft period.
claims.quote: However, due to the elevated cost environment, we reported a net loss of 19 billion rupees.

claims.claim: Concluded widebody damp-lease operations effectively from November 1st for economic prudence.
claims.quote: In this volatile environment, we considered it economically prudent to conclude our widebody damp-lease operations with effect from 1st November.

claims.claim: Reported total income of 256 billion rupees, up ~19% YoY, with yield growth of 21.3% and net loss of 2.4 billion rupees.
claims.quote: Moving to the financial performance for Q1 FY27, we reported a total income of 256 billion rupees, a growth of around 19% year over year, with a yield growth of 21.3% and a load factor reduction of 1.3%.

claims.claim: June quarter capacity growth came in at 3% YoY, broadly in line with guidance.
claims.quote: June quarter’s capacity growth came in at 3% on a year-over-year basis, broadly in line with our guidance.

claims.claim: Fuel CASK increased by around 80% year-on-year due to a 50% rise in Brent and 120% rise in Singapore jet fuel prices.
claims.quote: Despite this measure, our fuel CASK increased by around 80% year-on-year.

claims.claim: Inducted 13 aircraft, redelivered 9 original orderbook and 13 damp-leased aircraft, closing fleet at 432.
claims.quote: We inducted a total of 13 aircraft from our original orderbook... We redelivered 9 aircraft from our original orderbook and 13 damp-leased aircraft during the quarter resulting in a total closing fleet of 432 aircraft at the quarter end.

claims.claim: Middle East capacity is currently operating in the north of 90% levels.
claims.quote: Today, probably it's going to be in the north of 90% capacity that we are operating.

claims.claim: Early December operational disruptions led to cancellations of over 2,500 flights and delays of hundreds of flights.
claims.quote: Now, I want to address the operational disruptions that began in the first week of December and that led to cancellations of more than 2,500 flights and delays of hundreds of flights

claims.claim: In calendar year 2025, IndiGo received 57 aircraft and was the largest recipient of Airbus aircraft globally for the second consecutive year.
claims.quote: In terms of fleet addition, in the calendar year 2025 we received deliveries of 57 aircraft from our original orderbook... position as the largest recipient of Airbus aircraft globally for the second consecutive year
